Jambagi Assistant ProfessorB.Com (PES College), M.Com (Bangalore University), M.Phil. (Dravidian University), KSET and PGDBA Linkedin Link An accomplished educator with over 21 years of teaching experience, she holds an M.Com, M.Phil., KSET and PGDBA (2 years). Currently serving as an Assistant Professor at SSMRV College, she has contributed extensively to research, curriculum development and student mentoring. She has presented and published several research papers and actively participates in academic committees, faculty training programmes and student development initiatives. Specialisations and Interests Accounting Publications and Career Highlights Published research paper titled “A Study on Scope of Business Growth Through Sustainable Innovation by Value Creation to Unfamiliar Ayurvedic Herbs in India” in International Journal of Management and Social Science Research Review (IJMSRR), Volume 10, Issue 8, August 2023, pp. 60–71 (Impact Factor: 6.462) Published research article titled “A Study on Plastic Waste Towards Tarring of Roads Using Plastic Bitumen in Bangalore City” in Indian Journal of Natural Sciences (IJONS), Volume 15, Issue 84, June 2024 Papers Presented at Conferences Virtually presented paper titled “The Education Shift from Traditional Approaches to Modern Approaches: A Study in Bengaluru City” at a two-day National Conference sponsored by the Indian Council of Social Science Research, organised by Virudhunagar Hindu Nadar’s Senthikumara Nadar College, Virudhunagar, on 24 and 25 January 2023 (ISBN 978-81-951746-2-1) Back to Faculty Stay Connected With Us At Quick Links About SSMRV Programmes Placement Policies and Procedures Address #17, 36th Cross road, 26th Main, 4th T Block East, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560041 Email ID office.ssmrv@rvei.edu.in principal.ssmrv@rvei.edu.in Contact Numbers Landline No. - 080 6824 0999 Mobile No. - 96060 67553 For Admission 9739588855 / 9739655500 / 9606537192 Find Us At Facebook Instagram Linkedin X-twitter Youtube Designed by Department of Alumni Affairs & Communication
